headline: Copper drops to seven-month low amid technology sector uncertainties
summary: International copper prices fell to a seven-month low following volatility in technology stocks, threatening export revenue projections in major producers like Peru.
why: Copper is a foundational industrial metal heavily utilized in power generation, electronics, and global construction.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Technology equity turbulence triggered broader commodity price declines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Doubts surrounding tech hardware spending spilled over into industrial metal markets, knocking copper to multi-month lows.
